patch_description: Remove the counterproductive recent additions (separate ent_off parameter, ZZ gates, CZ gates) that increased complexity without improving scores. Return to the simpler 6-parameter structure. Then extend the successful odd-qubit ry_mid→rz_final bracketing pattern to even qubits {0, 2, 4, 6} to create symmetric parity-based decision boundary sharpening. This should improve worst_group_margin (currently 0.35) back to 0.36+ while reducing parameter count and depth.
